title: Input copying phase
statement: For natural numbers $c,C$, a Boolean input word $x$, and every $i\le |x|$, after $i$ steps the unary polynomial generator started on $x$ is in its copy-phase configuration with $i$ unary marks on each work tape and the input head advanced past $i$ symbols.
replaced:
For every $i \le \abs{x}$, after $i$ steps from the generator's initial
configuration on input $x$ the machine is in the copy-phase configuration
with $i$ unary marks on every work tape.
